design_disclosure.chosen_after_train_results: This bundle design (the v4 simulator + v7's prediction package + v8's stat-line bundle as v8 shipped it + cycle 5's capability parts, judged by ONE bundle-level gate) was chosen AFTER v7's and v8's binding TRAIN gate results were known: v7 passed 32 of 33 checks and failed only its close-regime winner bound (-0.0024 [-0.0054, +0.00054]); v8's every-flag-on arm vs v4 on train (descriptive, 2020-2023): engine winner -0.0080 [-0.0125, -0.0036], total stat-line deviance -0.80% [-1.35%, -0.24%]. The per-part gates of v7 and v8 rejected bundles whose parts helped jointly. NO validation (2024-2025) number and NO vault (2026) number informed this design.
design_disclosure.what_that_implies: (1) The PRIMARY is the contrast v7's check 'C1 open winner' measured: same fights, same comparator files (cmp4 = versions/v7:cmp4 with the same per-year stackers), same seed rule and sims, and the same winner rows, because the v10 winner (the ML v2 head stack of the line regime) does not read the simulator. Expected result, stated now: v7's C1 open number reproduced exactly, -0.00528 [-0.00964, -0.00097] (any difference means the wiring changed). (2) The CO-PRIMARY is the contrast v8's descriptive all-on run measured, now on 2021-2023 with a new seed (10): expected about -0.8% with a CI well below +0.5%. So this gate is a pre-stated consistency and wiring check of the consolidated bundle, NOT independent evidence that the bundle helps. (3) The open regime (plan 7.1 item 1's v6 primary) and the tolerances (plan 6.3 / 7.1 item 4) pre-date these results, but the decision to judge the bundle on the open regime only (v7's failing close check becomes descriptive) and to drop the 7-bin / method bounds that decided v8's and v9's gates was taken with those train results in view. Labels carried to the pre-registration and to audit 2: 'gate design informed by v7 / v8 train results'; 'confirmation look' (every ingredient was scored on 2024-25 in research).
design_disclosure.plan_deviations: (a) V6_V10_PLAN cycle 5 planned v10 as a capability-only cycle ('every scored 2024-25 number identical to v9's'); v9 failed its gate, and this cycle consolidates cycles 1-3, so scored numbers change and the look is a normal branch-1 / branch-2 look. (b) Plan 6.1 allows a component that PASSED its train gate to be re-bundled once; cycle 1's parts were re-bundled once already (v7) and failed there, v8's parts never passed a gate. They enter v10 only through this bundle-level gate, by the owner's cycle instruction; recorded as a deviation from 6.1's per-part re-bundling. (c) v9's parts: none passed its own train gate (v9 had one bundle gate and failed 8 of 14), so none is in v10 (v9's decision called the format pass a re-bundle candidate, but 6.1 requires a passed gate). (d) Cycle 5's anchor-direction regression, kappa-style band calibration, realism report by division and the page build slots (work item 2) are NOT built in v10; the explainer coherence is delivered by FightEngine.showFight instead (below).

gate_rules.primary: open-regime winner log loss, v10 package minus cmp4, decisive 2021-2023 fights with an opener for both packages; PASS iff point < 0 AND paired 95% CI upper <= +0.002 (V6_V10_PLAN 6.3 winner not-worse tolerance)
gate_rules.co_primary: total stat-line relative deviance (tools/v8_gate.py definition) of the v10 engine (stat-harness arm 'all') minus v4 (arm 'cmp4' = every v8 flag off) on 2021-2023; PASS iff paired 95% CI upper <= +0.005 (+0.5% of level)
gate_rules.integrity: both binding harness runs complete with 0 failed fights; data/derived/v10/tests/test_v10.json (the frozen files) has 0 failures
gate_rules.verdict: PASS iff primary AND co-primary AND integrity
gate_rules.bootstrap: 20,000 event-cluster resamples (seed 7), Monte Carlo SE of each bound, a bound within 2 MC SE of its threshold decided by the clustered normal bound
gate_rules.descriptive_only_never_gating: no-line and close regimes; Brier / accuracy / ECE / slope / 7-bin / method / joint / round given a finish / method given the winner / P(decision); the full package with props vs cmp4 and vs v10 without props; per-part leave-one-out of the package (-props, -simulator: the v4 simulator's cells, -S2: S / SM cells, -winner: the MoE stack) and of the engine (-embed, -retarget, -tdIntent; -ctrlSpread is not run: sd 0 is a no-op); stat-line base rates and PIT; who x how x when vs methodround model S; wiring checks; the look's MDE and power

capability_checks.rule: the cycle-5 capability parts never move a backtest-universe prediction; each ships ON in versions/v10 only if its checks pass. A failed capability check turns that part's flag off before any look (a change verified by test_v10's identity checks not to move a scored number) and is recorded; it never changes the gate verdict.
